annotations.title: Check if a Dutch company is bankrupt (paid)

description: Use when you need to know if a Dutch company is bankrupt or in suspension of payments: live check in the Centraal Insolventieregister (Rechtspraak) with active and ended cases, court, case number, dates, administrator and claims deadline. Legal entities only. Input: KvK number or company name. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key.
name: nl_insolvency_check
title: Check if a Dutch company is bankrupt (paid)
